test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I thought the actress / to be she, / but I / was not sure.
solution:
The erroneous part is option 1) i.e. 'to be she.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part 'to be she.'
 
• The given sentence is in simple past tense because it starts with **'I thought,' **here the verb **'thought'** is in past form.
 
• According to the rules of grammar, the verb **'to be'** in the erroneous part need to be ins the past form which is **'was.' **
 
• Therefore in the given sentence we need to use 'was' in place of 'to be' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Correct sentence:__* I thought the actress **was she,** but I was not sure.*
